reason: The authoritative order, assigned SHA-256, canonical URL, fixed worker schema, candidate/receipt equality, suggestions/receipt equality, source-target absence, path-qualified raw backlink, all five exact excerpts, linked cross-source authorities, target concepts, and deterministic wiki validation were verified. The candidate accurately preserves the outbound Metronome-to-Salesforce direction, per-environment package and Census setup, customer selection and Salesforce-account linkage boundary, activation and daily cadence, changed-row monitoring, 100-failure sample limit, object-family schemas, Draft/Finalized prose versus Void enum ambiguity, downstream-outcome limits, and the separate Salesforce-to-Metronome reconciliation example. The twelve submitted shared updates are directly supported by their quote indexes. Approval is blocked by an incomplete concept-impact sweep and corresponding source coverage: the raw directly establishes a Salesforce customer-ingest-alias replica that affects the event-ingestion authority, and a credit-type/currency object plus invoice and invoice-line credit-type lookups and an unresolved commit-denomination surface that affect the currencies authority. Those are durable integration facts, not tangential references, so the retry requires another full review.
